annotation.bound_parties_text: The Act binds the Secretary of State (listing and reporting duties), insurers and owners of automated vehicles (liability), and operators of public charging or refuelling points, large fuel retailers and service area operators (via regulations).
annotation.bound_parties_quote: the insurer is liable for that damage.
annotation.dates_quote: This Act comes into force on whatever day or days the Secretary of State appoints by regulations.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: An Act to make provision about automated vehicles and electric vehicles.
